title: Packaging Design Brief: Dancing Fish Granola Berry Crunch

sections.title: Product Overview
sections.content: Granola Berry Crunch is an oven-baked, high-grain granola manufactured under the brand Dancing Fish. The product is intended for distribution within the United States and the broader North American market. It is accompanied by the consumer marketing tagline encouraging buyers to start tapping, swishing, and shaking their tail fins.
sections.confidence_reason: Product identity, brand name, market region, and marketing tagline are directly corroborated by primary facts.

sections.title: Packaging Requirements
sections.content: The packaging format is a carton holding a net weight of 480g. Required identification codes include the label identifier DF-GRAN-BERRY-US-001, brand product number DF-BERRY-480G-US, and UPC barcode 1 20000 00003 6. The exterior carton must also display a recyclable paperboard mark and the Packaging powered by Esko logo.
sections.confidence_reason: Package form factor, identifiers, and required partner logos are clearly stated in the facts.
sections.review_reason: The fact-checker flagged previously omitted mandatory identification codes and truncated text.

sections.title: Mandatory Content
sections.content: The carton requires a US FDA Standard vertical nutrition panel listing 8 servings per container, a serving size of 85, 166 calories per serving, and the standard Daily Value advisory footer. Mandatory package text includes the full ingredient list led by organic wholegrain oat flakes (79%), honey, coconut sugar, dried fruit, nuts, and seeds. An allergen statement warning of almonds, pecans, walnuts, Brazil nuts, nuts, oats, and cereals containing gluten must be displayed alongside storage instructions to store in a cool, dry place. Best-before date coding is required on the base of the pack.
sections.confidence_reason: All regulatory, nutrition panel, allergen, and storage statements are explicitly recorded.
sections.review_reason: The fact-checker flagged previously truncated mandatory regulatory statements, ingredients, and allergen warnings.

sections.title: Claims & Certifications
sections.content: The product communicates dietary claims including Certified organic, GMO free, suitable for vegetarians (vegan), and with no artificial additives. It also bears verified claims for being Oven Baked and having No Added Sugar. Certifying bodies, official certification seal artwork, or formal registry numbers are not specified in the source data.
sections.confidence_reason: Specific marketing and dietary claims are documented, though accreditation entity details are absent.
sections.review_reason: The fact-checker flagged truncated claim phrasing and omitted verified claims.

sections.title: Design Direction
sections.content: General aesthetic guidelines, color palettes, typography, and carton die-lines are not determined from sources. However, the packaging design must incorporate verified text marks, specifically the recyclable paperboard mark and the Packaging powered by Esko logo.
sections.confidence_reason: Aesthetic style is not provided in source data, but required partner and recycling marks are identified.
sections.review_reason: The fact-checker flagged truncated text and omitted available branding marks.

sections.title: Open Questions for Agency
sections.content: The agency must verify how the 'No Added Sugar' claim aligns with the inclusion of honey and coconut sugar in the ingredient list under US FDA guidelines. Confirmation is also needed for the precise unit of measure for the serving size entry of 85. Additionally, the agency should identify the specific organic certifier logo required and obtain structural carton dimensions.
sections.confidence_reason: Derived directly from potential regulatory conflicts between ingredient statements and nutritional claims.

The unit of measurement for serving size 85 is not explicitly designated (e.g., grams).
